To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Cu0.2 Ni0.2SnO.2Ba0Fe2O4 nanoparticles have been synthesized by a simple wet chemical method using ethylene glycol.
the synthesized particles are flaky in shape with the crystallite sizes in the range of nanometers.
ethylene glycol is an effective solvent and complexing agent, and the synthesized particles are superparamagnetic in nature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of Cu0.3Ni0.2 Sn0.2BaFe2O4 nanoparticles by a wet chemical route in ethyl glycol as chiral agent.
a facile synthesis of Cu0. 2Ni0. 2Sn0. 2Ba0. 4 Fe2O 4 nanoparticles by a wet hydroxy chemical route and their characterization.
the synthesis and characterization of nano Cu0.2 Ni0.2 Sn0.2 Ba0.4 Fe 2O 4 ferrite particles by wet chemical route.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the as-synthesised Cu0.2 Ni0.2Sn 0.2Ba 0.4 Fe 2O 4 nanoparticles have the potential for applications in magnetic recording media and microwave devices.
the Cu0.2 Ni0.2 Sn0.2 Ba0.4 ferrites synthesized at different annealing temperatures have a good crystallinity and the particle size is in the range of nanometers.
the as-synthetic sample has a superparamagnetic nature, and the sample annealing at 1050° C has an antiferromagnetic nature, which is confirmed by the magnetic measurements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully synthesized and characterized Cu0.2 Ni0.2 Sn0.2 Ba0.4 Fe 2O4 nanoparticles with a mean particle size of 11–28 nm by a wet chemical method.
the chelation of ethylene glycol and the use of sodium hydroxide at a pH of 8 have been used to synthesize the mixed Cu0.1Ni0.2Fe2O4 ferrite.
ethylene glycol is a suitable medium for the synthesis of nanocrystalline ferrites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ethylene glycol can be used as a solvent and complexing agent to synthesize nano-sized spinel ferrite.
the synthesized nanoparticles are suitable for the applications of magnetic recording, microwave devices, and magnetic refrigeration.
